title: Improper Link Resolution Before File Access ('Link Following') (CWE-59) in Elastic Cloud Enterprise (ECE) can lead to…
description: A vulnerability identified as Improper Link Resolution Before File Access (CWE-59) exists in Elastic Cloud Enterprise (ECE). This flaw can allow unauthorized disclosure and loss of data from other deployments on the same host through a symlink attack. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 8.2 CVSS v3.1, indicating significant confidentiality, integrity, and availability impacts. No specific affected versions or patch information are provided.
